lai56.title: Lai Street Apartments 5 & 6
lai56.subtitle: Interior Visualization
lai56.description: We refreshed the apartments on Lai Street in Tartu. Big thanks to our partners Dimension Estates, Moreelo, and Domus, who helped make this happen!

lai3.title: Lai Street Apartment 3
lai3.subtitle: Interior Visualization
lai3.description: A freshly renovated split-level apartment in the heart of Tartu, on Lai Street. It features two bedrooms and a cozy sauna. The project was built on a strong collaboration with Dimension Estates, Moreelo, and Domus.

lai10.title: Lai Street Apartment 10
lai10.subtitle: Interior Visualization
lai10.description: We renovated an apartment on Lai Street in Tartu, located on the second floor of a three-story building and featuring a lovely balcony. This project was born from a joint collaboration with Dimension Estates, Moreelo, and Domus.

kasteheina.title: Kasteheina Street Terraced House
kasteheina.subtitle: Interior & Exterior Visualization
kasteheina.description: A cozy terraced house has been completed in Elva! The building features five apartments, each with its own terrace and sauna. This project was made possible through a great collaboration with Dimension Estates and Lumen Real Estate.

astri.title: Astri Group's 3D Maps
astri.subtitle: 3D Digital Solutions & Wayfinding
astri.description: We created interactive 3D maps for five of Estonia’s top shopping centers, including Lõunakeskus—the largest in South Estonia. These user-friendly wayfinding maps are now available at Lõunakeskus, Astri, Fama, Pärnu Keskus, and Balti Jaama Turg. The projects were made possible through a great partnership with 3D Wayfinder.

galeria.title: Galeria Metropolia 3D Map
galeria.subtitle: 3D Digital Solutions & Wayfinding
galeria.description: Metropolia 3D Navigation: An interactive guide to one of Gdańsk's most unique shopping centers. The map helps visitors easily navigate through four levels and over 100 stores, including a dedicated interior and design area. The project was completed in collaboration with 3D Wayfinder.

vilnius.title: Vilnius Airport 3D Map
vilnius.subtitle: 3D Digital Solutions & Wayfinding
vilnius.description: Vilnius Airport 3D Wayfinding: We created a comprehensive digital twin of Lithuania’s largest airport. The interactive map helps passengers effortlessly find their way through the airport’s exciting architecture. The project was completed in collaboration with 3D Wayfinder.

tartu_hospital.title: Tartu University Hospital 3D Map
tartu_hospital.subtitle: 3D Digital Solutions & Wayfinding
tartu_hospital.description: Tartu University Hospital 3D Wayfinder: A smart solution for navigating Estonia’s largest hospital complex. The interactive map makes the large campus easy to understand, guiding patients and visitors effortlessly through the interconnected medical wings. The project was completed in collaboration with 3D Wayfinder.

twodmaps.title: Norway's Scala 2D Wayfinding Maps
twodmaps.subtitle: 2D Digital Solutions & Wayfinding
twodmaps.description: We created interactive 2D maps for several Norwegian shopping centers, making it easy to find shops at CC Strandtorget as well as Scala centers in Stortorvet, Rykkinn, and Trekanten. These projects were born from a close collaboration with 3D Wayfinder and Easy Touch & LED.

andreexterior.title: Chez Andre Exterior Cafe
andreexterior.subtitle: Exterior Visualization
andreexterior.description: I was commissioned by one of Tartu’s leading chefs to redesign his café’s exterior. The challenge was to balance the town’s historic aesthetic with a fresh, unique, and cozy atmosphere. Navigating new spatial regulations, I developed a custom bench solution that follows the building's facade, maximizing seating while maintaining a sleek, inviting look.

interior.title: INTERIOR VISUALIZATION
interior.description: High-quality 3D rendering for both residential and commercial spaces. We turn your project and interior design ideas into photorealistic visuals, leaving no room for uncertainty.

architectural.title: ARCHITECTURAL VISUALIZATION
architectural.description: We create detailed exterior views that provide a precise impression of the building's volume and materials in their actual context. We bring your residential or commercial projects to life visually.
